text: Thank you for sharing your symptoms. To better understand your condition, could you describe any changes in your urine or stool color, such as dark urine or clay-colored stools?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC) with possible superimposed cholangiocarcinoma given the history of ulcerative colitis.

REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal Ultrasound, MRCP.
